[[The Wingless Hive#Furious Frenzy|Furious Frenzy]]

title: Sloven Knight

flavor.value: ''Though Entropy weighs them down, if their blow finds purchase it is often devastating.''

summary: The Sloven Knight is an enemy in Monster Train 2. It is weak, but has high {{Health}} and gains {{Attack|+8}} if no other enemies are in front of it.

title: Ominous Acolyte

ability0.value: [[file:Rejuvenate.png|15x15px]] '''Recover''': Restore {{Health|15}} to enemy units after combat.

ring3.value: [[The Wingless Hive#Furious Frenzy|Furious Frenzy]]</br> [[The Wingless Hive#Hard Headed|Hard Headed]]</br> [[The Wingless Hive#Pyre Hunter|Pyre Hunter]]</br> [[The Wingless Hive#Corrupted Mass|Corrupted Mass]]</br> [[The Wingless Hive#More Mass|More Mass]]

flavor.value: ''To the Titans go the glory, and these worshippers keep their flock in line.''

summary: The Ominous Acolyte is an enemy in Monster Train 2. It is a backline healer in Rings 1-3.

title: Lurking Miscreant

ability0.value: {{IconLink|Resolve}}: Add a [[Chime of Despair]] card to the top of your draw pile.

ring2.value: [[Heaven's Gate#March of the Supplicants|March of the Supplicants]]

flavor.value: ''Though once they had a beautiful ring, their tone is now hollow and discordant. Perhaps only the corrupted can find beauty in it.''

summary: The Lurking Miscreant is an enemy in Monster Train 2. It is a backline enemy in Rings 1-3 that pollutes your draw with [[Chime of Despair]].

title: Energizing Flautist

flavor.value: ''Cherubs aren't merely Heaven's workers, they're also keepers of the Celestial Chorus, ensuring divine music always fills the Heavens. Even under the Titan's corruption, their music's never wavered.''

summary: The Energizing Flautist is an enemy in Monster Train 2. It grants allied enemies {{IconLink|Haste}}, causing them to move from the bottom floor directly to the top floor.

title: Yorael the First-Blessed

flavor.value: ''Yorael was a mighty warrior and first champion to be blessed by Savagery. Future blessings would prove more successful.''

summary: Yorael the First-Blessed is one of the possible [[Ring 1]] Bosses. He is a simple, no-frills boss with high immediate damage output.

title: Astreal the Lost

flavor.value: ''One of the Lost Souls, Astreal aimlessly wandered Heaven and Hell until Seraph took him in. But memories of Astreal's past still lingered in his soul, memories that Entropy could help him to forget...''

summary: Astreal the Lost is one of the possible [[Ring 1]] Bosses. He cannot attack at first due to his {{IconLink|Sap|6}}, but as combat is dragged out he will quickly become deadly.

title: Elebor the Wall

flavor.value: ''Elebor once mocked the Clipped, whose flight was forcefully taken from them. Now he too knows their pain.''

summary: Elebor the Wall is one of the possible [[Ring 2]] Bosses. He continually gains {{IconLink|Armor}} while battled, making high damage output paramount.

title: Legion

flavor.value: ''Dominion created something new from the willingness of the Forsaken to accept any power.''

summary: Legion is one of the possible [[Ring 2]] Bosses. He starts with {{IconLink|Spikes}}, and gains more of them as he ascends the train, making him very dangerous to fragile backline units.

flavor.value: ''"You might call me 'chicken' but I've done what I had to survive. Why do you think I am one of the few Angels who still has his wings?"''

summary: Arkion, Scion of Savagery is a [[Flying Bosses|major boss]] of [[The Wingless Hive|Ring 3]]. He appears as one of three variants.

stats1.value: Corrupted Mass: {{AttackHealth|7/680}}</br> Spiked Mass: {{AttackHealth|7/680}}</br> More Mass: {{AttackHealth|7/780}}

flavor.value: ''Dominion's blessing is a relentless pull that does not end with death. When Heaven's soldiers fall, they become the raw material for the next warrior. Cutting away one part of this monster only reveals more bodies feeding on the Titan's power.''

tables: Fixed an issue where the Titan [[Trial]] "More Mass" variant of [[Fleshweaver]] had fewer stacks of {{IconLink|Mass}} then intended. All Trial versions gain an additional 4 stacks of {{IconLink|Mass}}, which is now correctly added to the additional 3 stacks that this variant gains, putting it at 12 stacks of {{IconLink|Mass}} with the Trial enabled. Changed [[Fleshweaver]]'s {{IconLink|Mass}} status so that it is no longer removable via effects that remove Buffs.
summary: Fleshweaver is a [[Flying Bosses|major boss]] of [[The Wingless Hive|Ring 3]]. He starts with many stacks of {{IconLink|Mass}}, which raise his {{Attack}}, and which are lost on taking damage to spawn Fleshlings. He appears as one of three variants.

summary: #REDIRECT [[Fleshweaver]]

title: Undying Wretch

flavor.value: ''Dominion's blessing has for some meant renewed life, each worse than the last.''

summary: The Undying Wretch is an enemy in Monster Train 2. It cannot be killed in a single hit due to {{IconLink|Reanimate}}.

title: Misshapen Fiend

ring4.value: [[Trials#Mark_of_Invasion|Mark of Invasion]]</br> [[Celestial Forge#Hordes of Heaven|Hordes of Heaven]]

ring9.value: [[The Great Abyss#Clash with the Titans|Clash with the Titans]]

flavor.value: ''These disciples were one of the first to be corrupted, for they welcomed Dominion's blessings too readily. Now, they have paid the ample price.''

summary: The Misshapen Fiend is an enemy in Monster Train 2. They always spawn in groups, and apply {{IconLink|Corruption|3}} to your front unit on death. They appear in the [[Trials#Mark_of_Invasion|Mark of Invasion]] trial in Rings 4 and 5.

title: Vicious Axethrower

ring6.value:
[[High Heaven#Vampiric Feed|Vampiric Feed]]
[[High Heaven#Bloody Harvest|Bloody Harvest]]
[[High Heaven#Inevitability|Inevitability]]

flavor.value: ''Heaven's army was well-accustomed to violence, even during the peaceful age of the first Covenant. Not with Demons, but with other Angels. It was their main way of enforcing Heaven's strict hierarchy.''

summary: The Vicious Axethrower is an enemy in Monster Train 2. It is a basic backline enemy in Rings 4-6.

title: Malevolent Hunter

ring6.value:
[[High Heaven#Holy Feed|Holy Feed]]
[[High Heaven#Bloody Harvest|Bloody Harvest]]

flavor.value: ''Fast moving scouts, their connection to Savagery has made them only more deadly.''

summary: The Malevolent Hunter is an enemy in Monster Train 2. It is a backline enemy that enters with {{IconLink|Haste}}.

title: Sharp-Eye Sniper

ring9.value: [[The Great Abyss#Clash with the Titans|Clash with the Titans]]

flavor.value: ''Spiteful and always looking for the next kill to appear in their sight.''

summary: The Sharp-Eye Sniper is an enemy in Monster Train 2. It is a backline enemy that gets stronger on {{IconLink|Slay}}.

title: Adamant Shieldbearer

ring5.value: [[The Aviary#Corrupted Crusade|Corrupted Crusade]]</br> [[The Aviary#Relentless Zealots|Relentless Zealots]]</br> [[The Aviary#Undying Minions|Undying Minions]]

flavor.value: ''These disciples have guarded the palaces of Heaven for eons. They require no weapon, for their massive wall of a shield, along with Entropy's blessing, have made them an impenetrable bastion.''

summary: The Adamant Shieldbearer is an enemy in Monster Train 2. They are tanky enemies that appear in the frontlines, and apply {{IconLink|Sap}} to your units if you {{IconLink|Incant}} on their floor.

title: Fallen Executioner

ring4.value: [[Celestial Forge#Hordes of Heaven|Hordes of Heaven]]</br> [[Celestial Forge#Penance Seekers|Penance Seekers]]

flavor.value: ''Clipped wings were not the only form of punishment for disobedient angels.''

summary: The Fallen Executioner is an enemy in Monster Train 2. It is a basic tank enemy in Rings 4-6.

title: Blightbound Guardian

ring9.value: [[The Great Abyss#Clash with the Titans|Clash with the Titans]]

flavor.value: ''Dominion's whisper is most susceptible to those with a yearning heart. Even the most silent and obedient angels have desires buried deep beneath their stoic gaze.''

summary: The Blightbound Guardian is an enemy in Monster Train 2. It is a relatively tanky enemy that applies {{IconLink|Corruption}} to your front unit on {{IconLink|Strike}}.

title: Scarred Sentinel

ring9.value: [[The Great Abyss#Clash with the Titans|Clash with the Titans]]

flavor.value: ''These steadfast knights defend the upper reaches of Heaven. Forged through relentless trials, they bear their training scars with pride. No enemy's strike can match the pain they've already received.''

summary: The Scarred Sentinel is an enemy in Monster Train 2. It is a tanky enemy that gains {{IconLink|Titanskin}} as it ascends the train.

title: Ravenous Zealot

ring5.value:
[[The Aviary#Relentless Zealots|Relentless Zealots]]
[[The Aviary#Undying Minions|Undying Minions]]

ring6.value:
[[High Heaven#Vampiric Feed|Vampiric Feed]]
[[High Heaven#Bloody Harvest|Bloody Harvest]]

ring9.value: [[The Great Abyss#Clash with the Titans|Clash with the Titans]]

flavor.value: ''These angels that once used their bloodlust for power were the natural fit for Savagery's blessing.''

summary: The Ravenous Zealot is an enemy in Monster Train 2 that primarily appears in Rings 4-6. It is a tanky enemy that can deal very high damage if allowed to {{IconLink|Harvest}}.

title: Profane Supplicant

ability0.value: {{IconLink|Resolve}}: Add a '''[[Discordant Toll]]''' card to the top of your draw pile.

ring9.value: [[The Great Abyss#Clash with the Titans|Clash with the Titans]]

flavor.value: ''Heaven's bellringers, wielding a symbol of faith as their weapon, now toll their church bells as harbingers of Dominion.''

summary: The Profane Supplicant is an enemy in Monster Train 2. It is a backline enemy that pollutes your draw with [[Discordant Toll]].

title: Disciple of Ruin

ability0.value: [[file:Rejuvenate.png|15x15px]] '''Recover''': Restore {{Health|25}} to enemy units after combat.

flavor.value: ''These worshippers deliver the blessings of Dominion directly to the masses, reviving their spirits and their limbs.''

summary: The Disciple of Ruin is an enemy in Monster Train 2. It is a backline healer, essentially a more powerful [[Ominous Acolyte]].

title: Harpist Protector

flavor.value: ''The Celestial Chorus is an eternal melody, a celebration of the divine. Even demons of Hell cannot deny its beauty.''

summary: The Harpist Protector is an enemy in Monster Train 2. It grants enemy units {{IconLink|Titanskin|5}}.

title: Qel the Corruptor

flavor.value: ''Qel rose among Heaven's disciples, but a disciple can only go so far. He accepted Dominion's blessing, dreaming of wings of his own. But, Dominion had other plans.''

summary: Qel the Corruptor is one of the possible [[Ring 4]] Bosses. He applies {{IconLink|Corruption}} to your units on {{IconLink|Incant}}. At Covenant 4 and above, he also applies {{IconLink|Corruption}} to all of your units on all floors as soon as he enters the train.

title: Korin the Judge

ability0.value: {{IconLink|Relentless}}. {{IconLink|Summon}}: '''[[Descend]]''' all friendly units to this floor and '''[[Retreat]]'''.

flavor.value: ''Korin has seen ages of order and ages of chaos. For her, only her sense of justice has remained unwavering. Now even that has been perverted by the Titan's will.''

summary: Korin the Judge is one of the possible [[Ring 4]] Bosses. When she appears, all enemies still alive on the train will come to her defense.

title: Ajax the Unyielding

flavor.value: ''Ajax believed that the greatest sins were the ones that rippled through generations. This made him an easy target for Entropy, who has a similarly single minded view on the power of time.''

summary: Ajax the Unyielding is one of the possible [[Ring 4]] Bosses. He applies significant amounts of {{IconLink|Sap}} to your units in combat.

title: Quoto the Absolute

flavor.value: ''Quoto believed in the beauty of Heaven above all else. And now he believes in the beauty of something beyond it.''

summary: Quoto the Absolute is one of the possible [[Ring 5]] Bosses. He is a tanky boss with a huge amount of {{IconLink|Titanskin}}, but he loses a stack each time he's hit.

title: The Undying One

flavor.value: ''Dominion has cursed this angel with an undying life. With every resurrection, more with their mind fades, leaving only a hollow echo of what once was.''

summary: The Undying One is one of the possible [[Ring 5]] Bosses. They enter with 8 stacks of {{IconLink|Reanimate}}, prolonging the fight even after they have been "killed."

title: Cael, Lord of the Cherubs

ability0.value: '''Holy Feed''':</br>{{IconLink|Resolve}}: Grant {{IconLink|Damage Shield|1}} to the front non-boss enemy unit.<hr> '''Nourishing Feed''':</br>{{IconLink|Resolve}}: Grant {{Health|+35}} and {{IconLink|Spikes|4}} to the front non-boss enemy unit.<hr> '''Vampiric Feed''':</br>{{IconLink|Resolve}}: Grant {{Attack|+7}} and {{IconLink|Lifesteal|1}} to the front non-boss enemy unit.

ring6.value: Any combat titled '''Cael, Lord of the Cherubs'''

flavor.value: ''Cael, the eldest of Heaven's cherubs calls upon his kin with his illustrious horn. Now, it is Dominion that truly wields the horn.''

summary: Cael, Lord of the Cherubs is a [[Flying Bosses|major boss]] in Monster Train 2, and can be fought in [[Ring 6]]. He summons Cherubs which cannot attack, but provide buffs to other units by being {{IconLink|Eaten}}, similar to [[Morsels]]. Cael himself can both eat Cherubs and provide buffs to other units.

title: Hallow

ability0.value: {{IconLink|Titanskin|10}}. {{IconLink|Extinguish}}: [[Stryx]] gains {{IconLink|Titanskin|10}}. {{IconLink|Relentless}} begins next turn.<hr> Bloody Harvest: {{IconLink|Siphon}}: [[Stryx]] gains {{Health|+50}}.<hr> Doombringers: {{IconLink|Incant}}: [[Stryx]] gains {{Health|+30}}.<hr> Inevitability: {{IconLink|Resolve}}: [[Stryx]] gains {{Health|+60}}.

flavor.value: ''Fire and stone, impulse and consideration—one twin embraced the Titan's corruption while the other resisted. In the end, [[Entropy]]'s touch claimed Hallow, drawn by his yearning for stability. He accepted. For although he feared the Titan's power, he feared losing his sister even more.''

tables:
Fixed bug where killing [[Stryx]] or [[Hallow]] would sometimes give the other boss double status effects.

Fixed bug where you could not Ascend [[Stryx]] or [[Hallow]] after the other is defeated.

Fixed bug where boss rush score would not be calculated correctly when [[Stryx]] and [[Hallow]] are killed early. Fixed a rare bug where the game could softlock if [[Stryx]] and [[Hallow]] were killed under certain conditions.
summary: Hallow is a [[Flying Bosses|major boss]] of [[Ring 6]]. He appears as one of three variants, always together with [[Stryx]].

title: Stryx

ability0.value: {{IconLink|Multistrike|1}}. {{IconLink|Live to Fight|png=LiveToFight}}. {{IconLink|Extinguish}}: [[Hallow]] gains {{IconLink|Multistrike|1}}. {{IconLink|Relentless}} begins next turn.<hr> Bloody Harvest: {{IconLink|Revenge}}: Hallow gains {{Attack|+1}}.<hr> Doombringers: {{IconLink|Slay}}: Hallow gains {{Attack|+3}}.<hr> Inevitability: {{IconLink|Loop}}: Hallow gains {{Attack|+8}}.

flavor.value: ''Her mind might be consumed by the bloodthirsty delirium of [[Savagery]]'s corruption, but she has never forgotten her promise to protect her younger brother. Wherever Hallow flies, Stryx is always close by.''

tables: Fixed bug where killing [[Stryx]] or [[Hallow]] would sometimes give the other boss double status effects. Fixed bug where you could not Ascend [[Stryx]] or [[Hallow]] after the other is defeated.

Fixed bug where boss rush score would not be calculated correctly when [[Stryx]] and [[Hallow]] are killed early. Fixed a rare bug where the game could softlock if [[Stryx]] and [[Hallow]] were killed under certain conditions.
summary: Stryx is a [[Flying Bosses|major boss]] of [[Ring 6]]. She appears as one of three variants, always together with [[Hallow]]. Unlike most major bosses, she does not fly and instead moves around the train cycling back to the first floor due to having the status effect {{IconLink|Live to Fight|png=LiveToFight}}.

title: Purified Soul

ring9.value: [[The Great Abyss#Clash with the Titans|Clash with the Titans]]

flavor.value: ''These souls have been burned and purified by the Light of Seraph. Unfortunately for them, their pure form has now been tainted by the Titans.''

summary: The Purified Soul is an enemy in Monster Train 2. They always spawn in groups and appear in the [[Trials#Mark_of_Invasion|Mark of Invasion]] trial in Ring 7. Despite being extremely fragile at only {{Health|1}}, their {{IconLink|Spell Shield|2}} greatly limits your options for killing them.

title: Ragewing Assassin

ring9.value: [[The Great Abyss#Clash with the Titans|Clash with the Titans]]

flavor.value: ''Once one of Heaven's elite task force, Savagery has graced them with new powers and unleashed their urge to kill.''

summary: The Ragewing Assassin is an enemy in Monster Train 2. It is a backline enemy notable for its {{IconLink|Sweep}} ability.

title: Deformed Duo

ring9.value: [[The Great Abyss#Clash with the Titans|Clash with the Titans]]

flavor.value: ''A bond forged through combat has turned into a twisted codependency, their permanent bond fueling an onslaught of corruption.''

summary: The Deformed Duo is an enemy in Monster Train 2. It is a resilient backline enemy with {{IconLink|Reanimate}} that applies {{IconLink|Corruption}} on {{IconLink|Strike}}.

title: Celestial Bastion

ring9.value: [[The Great Abyss#Clash with the Titans|Clash with the Titans]]

flavor.value: ''It is somewhat poetic, in a way, that the very unwavering faith these soldiers had in Heaven was taken and transformed into a gruesome shell, forever encapsulating their bodies.''

summary: The Celestial Bastion is an enemy in Monster Train 2. It is a tanky frontline enemy with {{IconLink|Titanskin|10}}, making low-damage units and spells ineffective.

title: Avowed Gladiator

ring7.value: [[The Observatory#Dominion's Disdain|Dominion's Disdain]]</br> [[The Observatory#Purified Hordes|Purified Hordes]]</br> [[The Observatory#Savagery's Final Assault|Savagery's Final Assault]]

ring8.value: [[Heaven's Maw#Champion of Savagery|Champion of Savagery]]</br> [[Heaven's Maw#Chosen of Dominion|Chosen of Dominion]]</br> [[Heaven's Maw#Harbinger of Entropy|Harbinger of Entropy]]

ring9.value: [[The Great Abyss#Clash with the Titans|Clash with the Titans]]

flavor.value: ''Angels facing serious punishment were given one way to avoid banishment or execution: trial by combat. These Gladiators fought brutally to earn their place back in Heaven, but under a tight leash.''

summary: The Avowed Gladiator is an enemy in Monster Train 2. They are a common tank enemy in Rings 7-9, and have the highest {{Health}} of any non-boss enemy in the game.

title: Terrifying Amalgam

ability0.value: {{IconLink|Resolve}}: If you have no units on the floor, deals '''5''' damage to the Pyre.

flavor.value: ''Wyngh made their fair share of winged heavenly creatures, not just angels. Even before the Titans came, these riders were inseparable from their mounts. Savagery merely made their bonds permanent.''

summary: The Terrifying Amalgam is an enemy in Monster Train 2. It is a tanky enemy that unavoidably deals 5 damage to the Pyre on {{IconLink|Resolve}} if no friendly units survive on the floor.

title: Discordant Heretic

ability0.value: {{IconLink|Resolve}}: Add a '''[[Resonant Ruin]]''' card to the top of your draw pile.

flavor.value: ''Fervent worshippers of Dominion can deliver devastating curses to their foes, bringing them to their knees without delivering a single blow.''

summary: The Discordant Heretic is an enemy in Monster Train 2. It is a backline enemy that pollutes your draw with [[Resonant Ruin]].

title: Enthralled Ardent

ability0.value:
[[file:Rejuvenate.png|15x15px]] '''Recover''': Restore {{Health|40}} to enemy units after combat.
{{IconLink|Incant}}: Grant non-boss enemy units {{Attack|5}}.

flavor.value: ''The highest rank of Heaven's disciples, these ardents once helped steward Seraph's Light. They now wield it against us.''

summary: The Enthralled Ardent is an enemy in Monster Train 2. It is a backline healer that applies {{Attack}} to enemy units when you {{IconLink|Incant}} on its floor.

title: Deafening Herald

ring9.value: [[The Great Abyss#Clash with the Titans|Clash with the Titans]]

flavor.value: ''The Celestial Chorus can captivate even the fiercest foes. Those who hear its notes find themselves silenced, unable to resist listening to its deft notes.''

summary: The Deafening Herald is an enemy in Monster Train 2. It is a backline unit that applies {{IconLink|Silence}} to your units on its floor, preventing them from using [[Status_Effects#Triggers|Triggers]], [[Abilities]], and {{IconLink|Enchant}} effects.

title: Athane, Last to Fall

ability0.value: {{IconLink|Relentless}}.</br> {{IconLink|Incant}}: Apply {{IconLink|Spikes|1}} to enemy units.</br> {{Icon|Summon}} '''[[Ascension]]''': Spawn a '''[[Chosen Prayerstone]]'''.

flavor.value: ''The last of Heaven's champions to fall in battle. Athane was stoic and unyielding, prime qualities for Entropy. She was also Seraph's right hand, as a more obedient and powerful counterpart to Fel.''

summary: Athane, Last to Fall is one of the possible [[Ring 7]] Bosses. She protects herself with a [[Chosen Prayerstone]] and grants {{IconLink|Spikes}} to enemy units on {{IconLink|Incant}}.

title: Chosen Prayerstone
summary: #REDIRECT [[Athane, Last to Fall#Chosen Prayerstone]]

title: Rax the Overblessed

flavor.value: ''One by one, the Three tried and failed to defeat him. Each time they battled, Rax took on their powers until, without a fight, he was corrupted by their magic.''

summary: Rax the Overblessed is one of the possible [[Ring 7]] Bosses. He deals very high damage, strikes twice, and gets even stronger if allowed to {{IconLink|Resolve}}.

title: Seraph Aeternus-The Dominant

ability0.value: {{IconLink|Relentless}}.</br> {{IconLink|Strike}}: Double {{IconLink|Corruption}} on the attacked unit.</br> {{IconLink|Action}}: Apply {{IconLink|Corruption|2}} to your units.

flavor.value: ''Order, control, obedience. Dominion's promises of power were those which Seraph valued the most. It is no coincidence that of the Three, Seraph and Dominion are the most alike.''

summary: Seraph Aeternus-The Dominant is the [[flying boss]] of the Ring 8 [[Heaven%27s_Maw#Chosen_of_Dominion|Chosen of Dominion]] fight. He applies {{IconLink|Corruption|2}} to your units on {{IconLink|Action}} and doubles {{IconLink|Corruption}} on {{IconLink|Strike}}. If the [[Trials#Boss_Variants|Titan Trial]] is activated, his {{IconLink|Action}} instead applies {{IconLink|Corruption|4}}.

title: Seraph Aeternus-The Entropic

flavor.value: ''Seraph feared his own demise above all else. Eons of rule weren't long enough, he craved eternity. Entropy gave him the solution he longed for.''

summary: Seraph Aeternus-The Entropic is the [[flying boss]] of the Ring 8 [[Heaven%27s_Maw#Harbinger of Entropy|Harbinger of Entropy]] fight. He pollutes your draw with [[Curse of Entropy]] and applies {{IconLink|Sap}} to your units on his floor.

title: Seraph Aeternus-The Savage

flavor.value: ''Seraph saw himself as righteous, but those he punished knew of his true nature. Savagery's blessing was an excuse to finally allow himself to give into his lesser impulses.''

summary: Seraph Aeternus-The Savage is the [[flying boss]] of the Ring 8 [[Heaven%27s_Maw#Champion_of_Savagery|Champion of Savagery]] fight. He grants {{IconLink|Rage|3}} to enemy units on his floor. Additionally, your units enter with {{IconLink|Melee Weakness|1}}.  If the [[Trials#Boss_Variants|Titan Trial]] is activated, he instead grants {{IconLink|Rage|6}} and your units enter with {{IconLink|Melee Weakness|2}}.

title: Collector

ability0.value: {{IconLink|Resolve}}: Flees from battle if not {{IconLink|Rooted}} or {{IconLink|Dazed}}.</br> Rings 1-2: {{IconLink|Extinguish}}: Gain {{Gold|50}}.</br> Rings 4-5: {{IconLink|Extinguish}}: Gain {{Gold|75}}.</br> Ring 7: {{IconLink|Extinguish}}: Gain {{Gold|100}}.</br>

flavor.value: Cael's scavenger cherubs are constantly at work, searching for anything gold and shiny they can get their hands on. As for where these Cherubs stash Heaven's treasure, no one knows.

summary: The Collector is a special enemy that always appears in [[Rings]] 1, 2, 4, 5, and 7. At the start of turn 2 or turn 3 of combat, he spawns at the back of a random enemy floor. Killing him grants between 50 and 100 {{Gold}} depending on the Ring. Otherwise, he disappears from combat at the end of the turn. He can also be {{IconLink|Rooted}} or {{IconLink|Dazed}} to prevent him from fleeing. If {{IconLink|Dazed}}, he will not ascend and will instead end up in the front of the floor.

title: Skull Collector

ability0.value: Rings 1-2: {{IconLink|Extinguish}}: Gain {{Gold|50}}.</br> Rings 4-5: {{IconLink|Extinguish}}: Gain {{Gold|75}}.</br> Ring 7: {{IconLink|Extinguish}}: Gain {{Gold|100}}.</br>

flavor.value: ''Cael's scavenger cherubs are constantly at work, searching for anything gold and shiny they can get their hands on. As for where these Cherubs stash Heaven's treasure, no one knows.''

summary: The Skull Collector is a special enemy that replaces the [[Collector]] when the Skull Collectors [[Mutators|Mutator]] is enabled. Its behavior is identical to the Collector, but it never retreats from combat and it has increased stats.

title: Penitent Prayerstone

flavor.value: ''These statues were around long before the Titans came. No one knows what made them, or who these angels once were...''

summary: The Penitent Prayerstone is a special enemy featured in the [[Trials#Thorn Guard|Thorn Guard]] trial on [[Rings]] 4, 5, and 7. At the start of combat, a Prayerstone spawns at the front of each floor. The Prayerstones have high {{Health}} and {{IconLink|Spikes}}. Most units will be forced to fight through them before being reaching the enemy waves, taking {{IconLink|Spikes}} damage in the process.
